_purpose: Single centralized image registry/resolver source for CardStorm's visual layer. One verified mapping is reused by Product Intelligence, Grail Board, Team Hunt, Checklist views and Watchlist instead of each feature solving image lookup independently.
_schema: entityType(product|player|card|set) sport year player product set cardNumber parallel imageUrl repoAsset sourceUrl sourceType verificationStatus usageRightsStatus notes

Real-image sourcing was attempted this round via direct fetch and WebFetch against this player's Grail Board comp source URL(s); every auction-house/grading-company domain tried (fanaticscollect.com, espn.com, scpauctions.com/catalogs.scpauctions.com, cardladder.com, goldin.co) returned EGRESS_BLOCKED from this sandbox's network proxy - the same failure mode confirmed for topps.com/panini.com elsewhere in this repo, not assumed. Even where a listing photo might exist, it is the auction house's own copyrighted product photography with no confirmed redistribution license, so CardStorm keeps the branded fallback rather than guessing at usage rights.

Slab photo supplied directly by the CardStorm site owner as an image file - this sandbox has no outbound web access and could not fetch it itself. Identity independently cross-checked against the Grail Board record and confirmed exact: PSA cert #21400062, card #118, serial 1185/1250, PSA 10 - all visible on the slab/card match data/intelligence/grail-board.json's brady-2000-sp-authentic-118-psa10 record. This is a third-party auction house's own product photography (Fanatics Collect); commercial redistribution rights beyond the site owner's own use were not independently verified by CardStorm - flagged for the site owner's review before any public/commercial launch. Scoped to this exact year+set only.
